items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, public beta, public data display, alert expansion, affiliate or advertising expansion, and external outreach. Conditional only for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private; retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked; keep outreach unsent. Evidence: source rights for storage, derivatives, display, caching, alerts, trademarks, images, prices, and monetization are not established; all four legal launch tasks remain open; accuracy, freshness, security, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Human counsel is required for upstream rights and jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active. Progress: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed; 4 remain open: searchwoot-legal-source-rights, searchwoot-data-flow-retention, searchwoot-ga4-consent-evidence, and searchwoot-logs-vendors-incident. Existing API, terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and private-gate evidence is insufficient to close any task. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required. The source, purpose, processing, public display, historical derivatives, alerts, trademarks, images, prices, affiliate use, and advertising use are not supported by current rights evidence. Missing evidence: current written permission or API agreement; field-level provenance and rights; permitted storage, caching, display, derivative, and alert use; attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review.

Fleet compliance and evidence disposition: do not treat incomplete telemetry as a general growth blocker. The technical compliance baseline is 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown and is not legal certification. Analytics/data quality is yellow where permissions or collectors fail; do not treat unavailable sources as zero. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only, with $4.92 aggregate commission not site-attributable; do not infer revenue, ROI, margin, payback, or causal lift. For complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com, retain parked status because both are scaffold/parked, analytics are not configured, and compliance reachability is unavailable. Next evidence action for each is a timestamped private-site checklist covering reachability, content, disclosures, consent/cookies, privacy, terms, analytics, monetization, claims, provenance, copyright/trademark, platform policy, and age-sensitive concerns where applicable; record exactly one disposition: retain parked or bounded launch.
